description: The statement-level RAISING phrase (GOBACK / EXIT PROGRAM / EXIT METHOD / EXIT FUNCTION) - a 2002 introduction (the EC model); distinct from the PROCEDURE DIVISION header RAISING clause (procedure-raising-2002). The fixture's bare GOBACK also gates (0880) below 2002; the reject cells assert THIS row's 0879. Folded from the inline EcBinder gate (Exec Step E). The LAST phrase sits in a DECLARATIVE because §2023:14.9.18.3 SR5 admits it only there or in a WHEN phrase of a PERFORM: the probe's original ordinary-paragraph GOBACK became illegal source when PB410 landed that screen (COBOL2103), and CI caught it because no wave-local gate runs ~VersionMatrix. The EC-model declarative is the right host anyway - this row IS the 2002 EC model - and a Format-3 PERFORM was rejected as the alternative because it is 2023-only and would have broken the 2002/2014 compile cells.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.18.2 / §2023:14.9.14.2 Format 2 (exception propagation; the EC model is 2002+)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWSRA.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 W PIC 9 VALUE 1.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
DECLARATIVES.
D-SEC SECTION.
    USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT.
D-PARA.
    IF W = 2 GOBACK RAISING LAST EXCEPTION END-IF.
END DECLARATIVES.
MAIN SECTION.
MAIN-PARA.
    STOP RUN.
